description_full: Talamore Mining Corp. primarily engages in the identification, exploration, and evaluation of mineral properties in Canada, Chile, Mexico, and the United States. It explores gold, silver, and copper deposits. The company's flagship project is the Coffee Gold Project located in the Yukon, Canada. The company was formerly known as Fuerte Metals Corp. and changed its name to Talamore Mining Corp. in June 2026. Talamore Mining Corp. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

financial_summary: Talamore Mining Corp. is a small-cap basic materials business with a $705M market cap on $0 of annual revenue.
Returns on capital run at -164% against a 10% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests.
The company is burning through $4M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.

Net dilution runs at 7.1% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and insiders hold 51% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
